messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert P-55021 fired for service=az4-inference-pool, reason=pod_evictions_and_kvcache_pressure, severity=P1. Auto-escalation to on-call triggered.

pagerduty: Incident P-55021 created: https://pagerduty.example/in/c/55021

sam (oncall): Acked. I'm on it. Initial check: are we seeing autoscaler churn or underlying fabric flaps? :eyes:

alex (eng-sre): I'm seeing a bunch of HPA scale-down/scale-up cycles and pods stuck in Terminating in az4. CPU fine but node evictions from kubelet: OOMKills and kubelet eviction thresholds hit.

mira (platform): @sam @alex I'm checking the cloud provider metrics for az4. There was a correlating spike in host reprovisioning between 02:10-02:14 UTC. Could be a maintenance or a fabric issue.

jamal (runtime): Application-level: KV cache eviction rates jumped x15, token latencies for short chat requests spiked 4-5x. Some requests are hitting fallback successfully but we have partial routing failures. Logs excerpt:
```
[2026-03-14T02:11:12Z] runtime.kv: eviction_threshold_reached=1 count=1273
[2026-03-14T02:11:12Z] router: route_error=capacity_exceeded target=az4 reason=eviction_surge
[2026-03-14T02:11:13Z] http: 502 upstream_error=pod_not_ready host=az4-inference-03
```

tara (prod-support): We have 7 customer reports mentioning degraded latency in EU regions, some 502/503s. Sending a short status update to SMS list now.

sam (oncall): Runbook step 1: confirm fallback activation. Incident-bot, did the auto-fallback policy trigger?

incident-bot: Auto-fallback policy `regional-fallback-v2` evaluated: conditions met. Triggering fallback routing from eu-west-az4 -> weighted [eu-west-az1:60, eu-west-az2:40]. Fallback action id: fb-20260314-az4-01.

alex (eng-sre): Executing manual failover check: `kubectl get pods -n inference -l zone=az4` shows 12/35 pods NotReady. Patching routing config to force weight shift as a precaution. Command: `rtctl set-weight --region eu-west --zone az4 --weight 0 --reason "eviction surge"`

mira (platform): Confirmed cloud provider reported host reprovisioning job due to storage-health checks in az4. Opened ticket with infra provider, ref CP-9921. ETA unknown.

jamal (runtime): Temporary mitigations applied: lowered KV cache memory target, increased cache TTLs to reduce churn. Patch snippet: 
```yaml
kv_cache:
  max_memory: 1.2GB
  ttl_seconds: 45
```

tara (prod-support): Status update sent to customers: "We are experiencing capacity degradation in eu-west-az4. Traffic is being routed to other zones; some customers may see increased latency. We will update in 30 minutes." :email:

sam (oncall): PagerDuty escalation: notified ENG Director (level2) due to sustained P1 > 10m. @jamal can you run a quick canary validation against az1/az2 to ensure model quality unaffected?

jamal (runtime): Running eval on canary route now: `python eval_canary.py --model redwood-base --route eu-west-az1`. Initial 50 samples: pass (no regressions). Latency uplift ~+12% but within SLO for redirected traffic.

alex (eng-sre): Monitoring autoscaler settings; temporarily disabled aggressive scale-down while provider ticket is open to avoid churn. Command: `kubectl patch hpa inference-hpa -p '{"spec": {"behavior": {"scaleDown": null}}}'`

mira (platform): Provider acknowledges CP-9921, indicates control-plane risk mitigated but underlying host replace in progress. They estimate 20-40m for full stabilization.

sam (oncall): Next actions: 1) keep fallback active, 2) monitor customer-facing errors and latency, 3) prepare canary rollback plan if az1/az2 show regressions. I'll remain on-thread until we hit steady state or hand off to oncall-2.

tara (prod-support): Logged a follow-up ticket for Customer Success with impacted customer list and timelines. ID CS-4459.

incident-bot: PagerDuty incident P-55021 status changed to "Acknowledged" by sam (oncall). Auto-notify: oncall-escalation in 15m if not resolved.

sam (oncall): Handing off to mira (platform) at 02:45 UTC for monitoring and provider liaison. I'll update the incident timeline and summary. Handoff notes: fallback active, KV mitigations applied, provider ticket CP-9921 open, customer comms sent.

mira (platform): Taking over monitoring. Will post a postmortem template and assign action owners after resolution. @alex please keep autoscaler change recorded in the incident timeline.

jamal (runtime): Observability note: created prom alert rule `eviction_surge_persistent` to catch repeated eviction spikes and avoid cascading PD storms. PR will be opened in infra-alerts.

incident-bot: PagerDuty incident P-55021 updated: `fallback fb-20260314-az4-01` active, severity=P1, current assignees: mira (platform), alex (eng-sre), jamal (runtime).

sam (oncall): Pls react with :thumbsup: when you confirm you have the next steps covered. I'll stand down once mira confirms stable and no further customer escalations.

mira (platform): :thumbsup: monitoring green on az1/az2 routes, no new customer complaints in last 5m. Will keep this thread updated.

-- post-incident note planned: open root-cause investigation once provider stabilizes, include timeline, mitigation steps (fallback activation, cache tuning, autoscaler patch), customer impact summary, and follow-ups (alert tuning, runbook updates, prov-eng postmortem).
